notes.title: Sqvishy v1.0 out now!
notes.notes:
Hello you!

Version 1.0 is now live! Welcome to poor Sqvishy's nightmare... A special thanks goes to Big-Robot for granting permission for the standalone release of this small but lovingly formed minigame from "The Light Keeps Us Safe". We're planning to release an update soon that will allow you to set your own custom levels (grid size, no. of cube types/exits, cube roll speeds and spawn intervals etc) so keep your eyes open for that. In the meantime, get puzzling! x
